To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the optimal rebate mechanism in a dynamic CLSC game is a variable rebate policy and the CLSC firms should employ open-loop strategies in a dynamic game with a fixed rebate.

the CLSC profit is maximized by a variable rebate policy, the CLSC game is fully dynamic when firms employ a variable rebate policy and the open-loop Stackelbergequilibrium coincides with the Markov perfect Stackelelberg equilibrium if firms offer a fix rebate policy.

(1) the CLSC profits increase with a variable rebate, (2) the CLSC game is dynamic under a variable rebate, and (3) the open-loop Stackelbergequilibrium and Markov perfect equilibrium coincide under a fixed rebate.
